title: 2027 Postgraduate NRF Scholarships
about: The University of Pretoria lists six National Research Foundation scholarships for the 2027 academic year, from Honours to Doctoral level. Applications close 23 November 2026 at 15:55; the NRF call documents are attached to the UP funding page.
requirements: National Research Foundation (NRF) scholarships for the 2027 academic year
Six different scholarships available, from Honours to Doctoral level
Call documents attached to the UP funding page; faculty admission rules apply separately

Level "Honours, master's and doctoral" → objective "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
